parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: If set, only list tunnel hostnames that contain this value. The filter is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: canonical
parameters.description: If set, only list tunnel hostnames with the specified canonical status.

parameters.name: is_deleted
parameters.description: If `true`, only return deleted tunnel hostnames. If `false` or omitted, exclude deleted tunnel hostnames.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of results to display, up to 1000. The server caps larger values at 1000.
